reply.text: {"say":"Every leg movement here runs on the smith machine, opening with back squats and working through hinges, split stance, hip thrusts and calves.","title":"Smith Machine Legs","days":[{"name":"Smith Machine Legs","exercises":[{"key":"smith-machine-back-squat","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Feet slightly forward, sit straight down"},{"key":"smith-machine-romanian-deadlift","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Push hips back, bar close to legs"},{"key":"smith-machine-bulgarian-split-squat","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Rear foot on bench, control the descent"},{"key":"smith-machine-hip-thrust","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause and squeeze at the top"},{"key":"smith-machine-reverse-lunge","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Long step back, front knee tracks toes"},{"key":"smith-machine-calf-raise","sets":4,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Full stretch at the bottom, pause up top"}]}],"unmet":[]}
